objective: Split every agent prompt of claude-5.5 into one file per section, add an instruction-making guide for the root that follows Anthropic's Claude 5.5 prompting guide, and make stacked PRs and a live task list with few messages the root's defaults.
scope: Layout (decided): packages/runtime/src/instructions/claude-5.5/root/*.md one file per section of the current root.md; claude-5.5/specialist/*.md one file per section of specialist.md (writing-bar.md becomes a section file there or its own clearly named file); claude-5.5/roles/<role>/*.md one file per section of each role file. Section order is fixed in code (packages/integrations/claude/src/agents.ts), not by filename sorting alone, and a test fails when a file in those folders is not assembled or an assembled file is missing.

The core root rules (the <!-- core:start/end --> part, which packages/runtime/src/cli/sessioncontext.ts injects when the root is not the main thread and which sessioncontext.test.ts caps at 4000 bytes) stay identifiable as their own files and stay under the cap.

New claude-5.5/root/instruction-guidelines.md: the rules the root applies whenever it writes or reviews model-facing text (agent prompts, skills, Assignment briefs, instruction files, workflow scripts' prompts), following Anthropic's Claude 5.5 prompting guidance. Source: /home/davidbasile/dev/holyagent-reviews/claude-5.5-prompting-guide.md (cited, 134 lines; check snippets against the URLs before relying on them). It ships in the root prompt.

Bring the root and specialist text in line with that guide where it conflicts (for example add effort guidance, keep-working versus stop-and-report, and anything else section D of the guide file lists), without growing the text beyond what the change needs.

Stack plan (decided by the user): every PR of one delivery stacks in work order by default; the target repository's own conventions come first for mergeability. Replace the current 'stack only on a real code dependency' rule.

Task list and messages (user: 'você está atualizando as tasks? você está falando demais comigo / quero que reforce'): strengthen the core so the root creates the task list first, updates it at every dispatch, close and verdict, and writes to the user only for a decision, a blocker or the final report; progress lives in the list, not in messages.

Move the current workflow paragraph of root.md verbatim into its own root section file; a later change rewrites it. Do not touch packages/integrations/claude/src/workflows, WORKFLOW_NAMES, plan.ts or the workflow hook.
Update packages/integrations/claude/src/agents.ts and generate.ts, the instruction tests, docs/development.md and docs/decisions.md for the new layout; rebuild with `mise run build`.
constraints: Do not commit, push, branch or touch .git or .holyagent. Do not edit .claude/CLAUDE.md.

Expected size: the generated agent files grow by at most the new instruction-guidelines section plus about 10% of the current root and specialist text; report the before/after byte counts of dist/agents/*.md.
US English for model-facing text; follow the writing bar already in the repository.

criteria.text: Every agent prompt section lives in its own file under claude-5.5/root, claude-5.5/specialist or claude-5.5/roles/<role>, and the generated agents are assembled from them in a fixed order checked by a test.
claude-5.5/root/instruction-guidelines.md exists, is in the generated root agent, and each rule traces to the cited Claude 5.5 guidance.
The root text makes stacking every PR of a delivery the default with repository conventions first, and requires the live task list with messages only for decisions, blockers and the final report.
Apart from the intended text changes, the generated agents keep their content: report a diff summary of dist/agents before and after.
The core stays under the 4000-byte cap and sessioncontext still injects it.
Tests cover the assembly order and the presence of every section file.
`mise run verify` passes and the committed dist equals a fresh build.
No change to prebuilt workflows, their hook or plan.ts.
Follows .claude/CLAUDE.md (JSDoc on exports, skill descriptions start with the situation).

result: result: Instruction prompts split one file per section (root/, specialist/, roles/<agent>/), instruction-guidelines.md in the root, stacking, task-list and language defaults; verify exit 0 (552 pass), both strict validations pass.
